description: Java class implementing a custom Log4j filter 'OFBizDynamicThresholdFilter' that checks for active individual log levels based on context data, adapted from Log4j's DynamicThresholdFilter.

classes.name: OFBizDynamicThresholdFilter
classes.description: Custom Log4j filter that dynamically checks log levels based on context data, with filtering logic and configuration.

methods.name: createFilter
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of OFBizDynamicThresholdFilter with specified key, pairs, onMatch, and onMismatch actions.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Overloaded methods to determine if a log event should be accepted based on level and context data.

methods.name: currentContextData
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's context data for filtering.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key used for context data lookup.

methods.name: getLevelMap
methods.description: Returns the map of string levels to Level objects.
